description: Search the World Network of Biosphere Reserves (UNESCO Man and the Biosphere Programme) by keyword, country, region, MAB regional network, designation year range, transboundary or Small Island Developing States status, or distance from a point. Every keyword must appear at the start of a word in the reserve's name, introduction, or ecological or socio-economic description; there is no biome or ecosystem field, so an ecosystem search is a keyword search such as mangrove or alpine. A country is an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code. A transboundary reserve appears once per participating country, each with its own mab_id. Results page with next_cursor and carry facet counts over the whole match.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code, any case (FR, FRA). Matches the reserve's country; a transboundary reserve has one row per participating country. For a country name, look up its code with unesco_list_reference (topic countries).

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor from the previous call's next_cursor. Pass it with the same filters and sort to fetch the next page.

include_description.description: Set false to leave each row's introduction out of the response (default true); unesco_get_biosphere_reserve returns it. Which reserves match, their order, and matched_in are unchanged.

near.description: Only reserves within radius_km of this point. Every reserve has coordinates.

latitude.description: Latitude of the point, in decimal degrees (−90 to 90).

longitude.description: Longitude of the point, in decimal degrees (−180 to 180).

radius_km.description: Search radius in kilometres (up to 5000, default 100).

query.description: Keywords; every word must match the start of a word in the reserve's name, introduction, or ecological or socio-economic description. Case, accents, and punctuation are ignored, so the query must contain at least one letter or digit and at most 16 distinct words; no phrases, operators, or fuzzy matching. For an ecosystem, use a habitat word such as mangrove, wetland, or alpine.

region.description: UNESCO region: Africa, Arab States, Asia and the Pacific, Europe and North America, or Latin America and the Caribbean (codes AFR, ARB, APA, EUR, LAC accepted). Matches any of a reserve's regions.

regional_network.description: MAB regional network, by full name or acronym (AfriMAB, ArabMAB, EABRN, EuroMAB, IberoMAB, SACAM, SeaBRnet), any case. A few reserves belong to no network.
enum: Europe and North America Biosphere Reserve Network (EuroMAB)
South and Central Asia MAB Network (SACAM)

sids.description: true: only reserves in Small Island Developing States. false: only reserves elsewhere.

sort.description: Result order. Default: relevance when query is set, else distance when near is set, else name. relevance needs query; distance needs near. area_largest orders by total recorded area.

transboundary.description: true: only transboundary reserves (one row per participating country). false: only single-country reserves.

name: unesco_search_biosphere_reserves

applied_filters.description: The filters and sort as the server applied them.

code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code the country input resolved to.

enum: Europe and North America Biosphere Reserve Network (EuroMAB)
South and Central Asia MAB Network (SACAM)

sort.description: The sort applied (resolved default when none was given).

cap.description: The page size (limit) that was applied.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_country`: country is not a recognized ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code, such as a country name or an unassigned code. `invalid_year_range`: designated_from is later than designated_to. `sort_needs_input`: sort relevance without query, or sort distance without near. `cursor_mismatch`: cursor was issued for different filters or sort, or for an earlier data snapshot. `invalid_cursor`: cursor is malformed, or its offset or limit is not a non-negative whole number. `snapshot_unavailable`: No MAB snapshot has loaded yet and the Data Hub is unreachable. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

facets.description: Facet counts over the whole match, not just this page.

region.description: Matching reserves per region; a reserve in two regions counts in both.

regional_network.description: Matching reserves per MAB regional network; "none" counts those in none.

sids.description: Matching reserves by Small Island Developing State status.

true.description: Matching reserves in Small Island Developing States.

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor, with the same filters and sort, to fetch the next page. Present when more results remain.

notice.description: Guidance on the result: why nothing matched, caveats, or how to continue paging.

area_marine_hectares.description: Total marine area in hectares, as recorded.

area_total_hectares.description: Total area in hectares, as recorded (unit inferred; undocumented upstream).

country.description: Country name as UNESCO records it.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the reserve country.

distance_km.description: Distance from the near point in km (present when near is set).

introduction.description: UNESCO's introduction to the reserve; omitted from every row when include_description is false.

mab_id.description: Biosphere reserve id; pass to unesco_get_biosphere_reserve for the full record.

matched_in.description: The first field tier by which every query word had matched (present when query is set).

population_total.description: Resident population, as recorded; 0 can mean none or unreported.

regional_network.description: MAB regional network, when the reserve belongs to one.
enum: Europe and North America Biosphere Reserve Network (EuroMAB)
South and Central Asia MAB Network (SACAM)

regions.description: UNESCO regions the reserve belongs to.

sids.description: True when the reserve is in a Small Island Developing State.

transboundary.description: True for a transboundary reserve; each participating country has its own mab_id.

shown.description: Number of results on this page.

sources.description: Datasets this response was built from.

attribution.description: Credit line to reproduce with the data.

data_as_of.description: Dataset's data_processed timestamp (ISO 8601) from the loaded snapshot.

license.description: Dataset license from the dataset metadata ('CC BY-SA 4.0').

truncated.description: True when more results remain beyond this page.
